About the Artist

Angelina “Angie” Xiong

Angelina “Angie” Xiong

Angie is an artist and writer whose illustrations pair sweetness with storytelling — cherry-topped Christmas cakes, cats guarding their cupcakes, and one very brave red-haired warrior.

As a student at Palmetto Christian Academy, she won Scholastic Art & Writing Awards, announced by the school in February 2023. Her essay “Iron Sharpens Iron: Building a Woman” honors the women who shaped her creativity — her mother, who kept every drawing from her childhood, and her best friend Bella, her brainstorming partner since fourth grade.

Angie is now a university student. This gallery is still growing — new pieces are on their way to the wall.

“As iron sharpens iron, the women in my life, my mother and best friend, have influenced me so much, and I can’t imagine what life would be without them.”
From “Iron Sharpens Iron: Building a Woman”

As Featured In

Featured Artist

Charleston Women Magazine
Spring 2023

Angie was featured in Charleston Women magazine, whose Spring 2023 “Outdoor Edition” celebrated the style and strength of Charleston women.

Her essay “Iron Sharpens Iron: Building a Woman” appeared in the magazine’s Women in the Making series — a reflection on her mother and her best friend, the two women who first taught her to imagine.
